qAndA.answer: The Troublesome Truck, with a mischievous grin, remarks "Ooh! Scary!" mocking James' fear and implying enjoyment in causing trouble.

qAndA.answer: Smudger is a black tender engine. His dark color and design reinforce his sinister nature.

qAndA.answer: Smudger doesn't explicitly state the location, adding to the mystery and suspense. His confident demeanor implies he possesses secret knowledge.

qAndA.answer: "February" likely signifies the release date of the full film. This tactic builds anticipation and leaves the audience with a sense of dread.
